remarks: Welcome to 136 Altruria Street, a beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 1-bath home in South Buffalo, where comfort, character, and convenience come together. A covered front porch greets you at the door and sets the tone for the whole home. Inside, new vinyl plank flooring runs throughout the first floor, giving the living spaces a fresh, modern feel. Two bedrooms and the full bath are conveniently located on the main level, offering flexibility for guests, a home office, or easy one-level living. The updated bathroom features a tiled shower, a new vanity, and new fixtures. Upstairs, two more bedrooms with spacious closets provide plenty of room to spread out. Major updates bring real peace of mind, including a roof installed in 2025 and brand-new electric service completed in 2026. Outside, the fully fenced backyard is ready for pets, play, and summer gatherings, and the 1-car detached garage adds practical space for parking or storage. Cazenovia Park is nearby for walks, recreation, and fresh air, and Mercy Hospital and a wide variety of local restaurants are a short walk or drive. Easy access to the 190, I-90, and NY-5/Buffalo Skyway puts downtown Buffalo, the Outer Harbor, and Canalside just a short drive away. Whether you’re a growing family or buying your first home, this move-in-ready home offers space, updates, and a location you’ll love. Showings begin immediately. Seller reserves the right to set an offer submission deadline.
